input.tender_text: GeM bid GEM/2026/B/10001 for supply of 500 business laptops. Submission deadline: 25 September 2026 at 15:00 IST. Estimated value: ₹90,00,000. EMD: ₹4,50,000 by online payment or bank guarantee. Bidder must have average annual turnover of ₹2 crore during the last three financial years, three years of similar supply experience, one completed order of at least ₹45 lakh, and an OEM manufacturer authorisation form. Delivery is required within 45 days. The tender does not state a pre-bid meeting date.
input.company_profile: ABC Systems Pvt Ltd has average annual turnover of ₹3.4 crore for the last three financial years, five years of laptop supply experience, a ₹62 lakh completed state-government laptop order with completion certificate, and an active OEM authorisation covering this product line. Available working capital is ₹38 lakh.

reference_answer:
## Decision
BID. ABC Systems clears the stated gates: ₹3.4 crore average turnover exceeds ₹2 crore, five years exceeds the three-year experience condition, and the ₹62 lakh completed order exceeds the one completed order threshold of ₹45 lakh. The active OEM manufacturer authorisation covers the required product line.

## Eligibility
Keep the three-year financial statements, ₹62 lakh completion certificate, and OEM manufacturer authorisation in the technical packet. Confirm the authorisation names the exact offered laptop model.

## Deadlines
Submit by 25 September 2026 at 15:00 IST. The pre-bid meeting is Not specified in tender. Lock the internal submission 48 hours earlier. Delivery is due within 45 days.

## Risks
The ₹4,50,000 EMD must be arranged in an accepted form. The principal execution risk is funding 500 laptops with ₹38 lakh working capital; secure an OEM credit line before bid submission.

## Action plan
Bid Manager: freeze compliance ownership today. Finance: arrange the ₹4,50,000 EMD and working-capital line. Technical: confirm model compliance. Document Controller: validate the completed-order evidence. Submit a portal-ready package before the internal deadline.

input.tender_text: State PWD e-procurement tender PWD/BLD/2026/77 for construction of a district office. Bid due 18 October 2026 at 17:00 IST. Estimated contract value: ₹8.2 crore. EMD: ₹16.4 lakh. Mandatory eligibility: valid State PWD Class I contractor registration on the bid date, average annual construction turnover of ₹10 crore, and two completed public-building works each above ₹3 crore during the last seven years. Joint ventures are not permitted. Completion period: 18 months.
input.company_profile: BuildRight LLP holds State PWD Class II registration. Average annual construction turnover is ₹12.6 crore. It has completed one public-building work worth ₹3.8 crore and one warehouse worth ₹4.1 crore. An upgrade application for Class I registration is pending and has not been approved.

reference_answer:
## Decision
NO-BID. The valid State PWD Class I contractor registration is mandatory on the bid date, but BuildRight holds only Class II and its upgrade is pending. Joint ventures are not permitted, so this disqualifier cannot be cured through a partner. The company also lacks two completed public-building works above ₹3 crore: the ₹4.1 crore warehouse is not stated to be a public building.

## Eligibility
The ₹12.6 crore average turnover clears the ₹10 crore threshold, but turnover alone cannot cure the registration and experience failures.

## Deadlines
The bid closes on 18 October 2026 at 17:00 IST. Completion is required within 18 months.

## Risks
Submitting without active Class I registration risks summary technical rejection and wastes the ₹16.4 lakh EMD arrangement effort. Treat the pending upgrade as unavailable until formally issued.

## Action plan
Do not submit this bid. Escalate the Class I upgrade and build a second qualifying public-building credential for future opportunities. Record this as a qualification loss, not a pricing loss.

input.tender_text: IREPS tender RLY/SIG/2026/204 for supply of signalling relays. Bid closes 6 December 2026 at 13:00 IST. Estimated value: ₹3.6 crore. EMD: ₹7.2 lakh. The offered product and manufacturer must hold valid RDSO approval on the bid date. Bidder must show three years of similar supply experience and average annual turnover of ₹5 crore. Joint ventures are not permitted. Delivery period: 90 days.
input.company_profile: SignalWorks India has six years of railway supply experience and ₹8.4 crore average annual turnover. Its RDSO approval application for the offered relay is under technical review and no approval certificate has been issued. The company has sufficient production capacity for 90-day delivery.

reference_answer:
## Decision
NO-BID. Valid RDSO approval is mandatory on the bid date, while SignalWorks' application is under technical review and no certificate exists. Joint ventures are not permitted, so a partner cannot cure the failure.

## Eligibility
Six years clears the three-year experience condition and ₹8.4 crore exceeds the ₹5 crore turnover threshold, but neither cures missing product approval.

## Deadlines
The bid closes on 6 December 2026 at 13:00 IST. Delivery is required within 90 days.

## Risks
Submission without valid RDSO approval risks summary rejection and unnecessary preparation of the ₹7.2 lakh EMD. A pending application must not be represented as approved.

## Action plan
Do not submit. Expedite the RDSO review, obtain the issued certificate, and target the next relay tender after approval. Record the opportunity as a qualification loss.
